:::{#thm-norm-dot-product}
#### Euclidean norm from the dot product

The [Euclidean norm](#def-euclidean-norm) of a vector $\vx$
is the [square root](algebra.qmd#def-square-root) of the [dot product](#def-dot-product) of $\vx$ with itself:

$$\norm{\vx} = \sqrt{\vx \cdot \vx}$$ {#eq-norm-dot-product}

:::

::: proof

$$
\ba
\norm{\vx}
&= \sqrt{\sumip x_i^2}
&& \text{(@eq-l2-norm)}
\\
&= \sqrt{\sumip x_i x_i}
&& \text{(} x_i^2 = x_i x_i \text{)}
\\
&= \sqrt{\vx \cdot \vx}
&& \text{(@eq-inner-product, with } \vy = \vx \text{)}
\ea
$$

:::
